units.source_text: “因此，如同男人不好一样，女人也有罪。

en.t: “Therefore, just as men are at fault, women too are guilty.

units.source_text: 不光是埃及，一般地说，东方的女子一旦结婚，

en.t: Not only in Egypt, but generally speaking, once women of the East marry,

units.source_text: 简直就像被抛入沉重的栅栏里，

en.t: it is almost as if they are thrown behind heavy bars,

units.source_text: 过着与姑娘时代判若两个世界的生活，

en.t: and they live a life utterly different from the world of their girlhood,

units.source_text: 自己也不知道这种婚姻悲剧的原因，

en.t: without themselves even knowing the cause of this marital tragedy,

units.source_text: 忘却了要保持女性美的事。

en.t: and they forget that they must preserve feminine beauty.

units.source_text: 埃及的妇女必须懂得真正的女性美，

en.t: The women of Egypt must understand true feminine beauty,

units.source_text: 因为如果不努力保持这种美，

en.t: because if they do not strive to preserve that beauty,

units.source_text: 就没有权利要求男人实行一夫一妻制。”

en.t: they have no right to demand that men practice monogamy.”

units.source_text: 于是，她一方面勇敢地主张一夫一妻制，

en.t: And so, on the one hand, she bravely advocated monogamy,

units.source_text: 另一方面开展鼓励已婚妇女变得更美的美容运动，

en.t: while on the other hand she launched a beauty movement encouraging married women to become more beautiful,

units.source_text: 并给它冠以“闺房仪式”的美名。

en.t: and gave it the elegant name “the bedroom ritual.”

units.source_text: 这是她设计的一种美容舞蹈。

en.t: This was a kind of beauty dance that she had designed.
